items.headline: Google Ads auto-extracts promotions from advertiser websites and applies them to Search and PMax campaigns.
items.summary: Starting October 12, 2026, Google Ads automatically identifies and extracts promotions such as coupons and deals from advertiser websites and applies them as promotion assets to Search and Performance Max campaigns that have linked location assets and no existing promotion assets. The feature is opt-out, meaning advertisers are enrolled automatically unless they take action to disable it.

items.headline: Meta updates ad terms effective Oct 30: advertisers bear legal responsibility for AI-generated creative.
items.summary: Meta is updating its Commercial Terms, Self-Serve Ad Terms, and Ad Creative Generative AI Terms on October 30, 2026, with the clearest change being the incorporation of the AI Creative terms into the Self-Serve Ad Terms.

items.headline: Snowflake launches AI Gateway for Advertising in preview, connecting enterprise data to Meta and TikTok ad signals.
items.summary: Snowflake introduced AI Gateway for Advertising in preview, using Model Context Protocol integrations for Meta and TikTok to connect enterprise data—including transaction histories, inventory, and conversion data—with live advertising information for campaign analysis.

items.headline: Google changed view-through conversion definition for Demand Gen Display ads on October 7, raising VTC counts.
items.summary: Google updated the view-through conversion (VTC) definition for Display ads inside Demand Gen from Active View—50% visible for one second—to a rendered impression of one pixel on screen for any duration, effective October 2026. This definitional change will automatically increase reported VTC numbers with no change in actual ad performance.

items.headline: Meta launches agentic AI in Ads Manager that creates campaigns and adjusts budgets via chat.
items.summary: On October 6, 2026, at Advertising Week New York, Meta announced that its AI business assistant in Ads Manager can now create campaigns, update targeting parameters, and adjust budgets through conversational prompts.

items.headline: OpenAI introduces a visual ad format in ChatGPT and expands third-party measurement integrations.
items.summary: OpenAI announced on October 5, 2026 a visual ad format to be initially tested during image generation in ChatGPT for Free and Go plan users in the US, with ads clearly labeled and kept separate from generated images.

items.headline: Google Search Console now shows AI Overview impression data globally but does not report clicks.
items.summary: As of August 31, 2026, Google's generative AI performance report became available in Search Console worldwide, showing how often pages appeared in AI Overviews, AI Mode, and generative AI features in Discover, broken out by page, country, device, and date.

items.headline: Amazon combines its ad console and DSP into a unified AI agent platform called Amazon Ads Agent.
items.summary: Amazon Ads announced it is merging its advertising console and former Amazon DSP—now called DVA—into a single platform called the Amazon Ads Agent, which maintains context across campaigns and makes AI-assisted campaign setup the default through DVA+.
